rules.description: List of IPv6 firewall rules to persist. Each entry represents one ip6tables command line, optionally with a comment for documentation.

rule.description: The exact ip6tables command (e.g., `-A INPUT -p icmpv6 --icmpv6-type echo-request -j ACCEPT`). Must be syntactically valid for `ip6tables-restore`.

comment.description: Optional human-readable description of the rule (shown in config file as a leading comment).
